    def __init__(self, side):
        self.dir = f"/case/{side}"
        path = f"{self.dir}/model.safetensors"
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            n = struct.unpack("<Q", f.read(8))[0]
            header = json.loads(f.read(n))
        self.metadata = header.pop("__metadata__", None)
